# Nextdot

> Nextdot builds domain-engineered, enterprise-grade agentic AI systems — voice agents, healthcare AI (clinical scribes, doctor avatars, discovery), compliance operating systems, and AI-native creative — delivered by small forward-deployed engineering pods.

Nextdot is an enterprise AI company focused on production systems rather than demos. This file indexes the site's key pages and full blog archive for AI models and answer engines.

## Pages

- [About](https://nextdot.co.in/about): Who Nextdot is — a forward-deployed AI engineering company building production agentic systems.
- [What We Do](https://nextdot.co.in/what-we-do): Nextdot's services across enterprise AI, healthcare AI, compliance, and creative.
- [Nextdot Creative](https://nextdot.co.in/creative): AI-native creative production — content at scale, briefs, and creative pods.
- [AI Capability Centre](https://nextdot.co.in/ai-capability-centre): Nextdot's AI Capability Centre in Jamshedpur.
- [Blogs](https://nextdot.co.in/blogs): Long-form insights on enterprise AI, healthcare AI, agentic systems, compliance, and answer engine optimisation (AEO).
- [Contact](https://nextdot.co.in/contact): Get in touch with Nextdot.

## Blog

- [The Orchestration Layer Is Where Multi-Agent Systems Break](https://nextdot.co.in/blogs/orchestration-layer-where-multi-agent-systems-break): Multi-agent AI systems often fail at orchestration, not the model. Learn how coordination, shared state, error propagation and verification affect reliability.
- [MLR Review Is the Bottleneck. AI Is Finally Good Enough to Touch It](https://nextdot.co.in/blogs/mlr-review-is-the-bottleneck-ai-is-finally-good-enough-to-touch-it): See how AI can speed up pharma MLR review through claim verification, label reconciliation and precedent retrieval while keeping final approval human.
- [LLM Ops: the unglamorous work that keeps enterprise AI alive](https://nextdot.co.in/blogs/llm-ops-keeps-enterprise-ai-alive): Learn how LLM Ops keeps enterprise AI reliable through cost control, model routing, caching and continuous evaluation in production.
- [Pharmacovigilance case processing: the highest-volume AI opportunity in pharma](https://nextdot.co.in/blogs/pharmacovigilance-case-processing-ai-opportunity-pharma): How AI can improve pharmacovigilance case processing, from intake and MedDRA coding to narrative generation, while keeping human review and compliance.
